_approach: The clipped 808 glide (Aesthetics Wiki: 'clipped 808 glides, booming sub-bass') carries the section alone as a low tomLow pulse under sparse clave squeak accents; kick appears only once, on the downbeat of bar 2, as a pickup into the next section. No hats at all — the bass glide's slides need the space. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
